smartScan.stepSelectHelp: Start with a type this account already scans. The full catalog is there when you need a different country or document.
smartScan.stepReviewHelp: These are the fields the scan will ask for. Front and back stay separate, so a name that appears on both sides is not a duplicate.
smartScan.stepUploadHelp: Upload the side that holds the fields you just reviewed. A second photo is asked for only when the document has a back.
smartScan.stepResultsHelp: Values are grouped by the side they came from. A document with one face stays in a single group.
smartScan.yourDocumentsHelp: These are the types this account has scanned most recently. Your own field list is used when you have one.
smartScan.yourDocumentsEmpty: No scans yet. Pick a document from the catalog below.
smartScan.allDocumentsHelp: Choose a country, then a type. This is the full catalog, including documents you have not scanned.
smartScan.onePhotoHelp: This document is a single picture. Only the front is read, and no back photo is required.
smartScan.frontPhotoHelp: Fields read from the front of the document.
smartScan.backPhotoHelp: Fields read from the back. Upload the back only when this document has one.
smartScan.uploadTwoSides: This document needs two photos. The front is first, then the back.
smartScan.templateCurrent: This scan did not store a template. The fields shown are the current template for this document type.
smartScan.resultsSidesHelp: Front values and back values are listed apart, including names that appear on both sides.
smartScan.governmentCheckLinked: This scan reads the photo, then calls {{name}}.
smartScan.governmentCheckMissing: This scan only reads the photo. Connect a government check to validate it.

wizard.smartCheckHint: Link any government endpoint from this country. It does not have to use this document's code.
